Definition
[Eigenvalue and eigenfunction] 1. ch4:4.1-def-1\group Separation of Variables For bounded open $U$, $\lambda $ is an eigenvalue of $-\Delta $ with zero boundary data if some nonzero $w$ solves \[ -\Delta w=\lambda w\text{ in }U,\qquad w=0\text{ on }\partial U. \] Such a $w$ is an eigenfunction.
